Job Description

Role Description :

Develop and execute activities related to end-to-end project management, including project plans and estimates, scoping and requirements through implementation and deployment.

Proactively Business Requirement Gathering from client, monitor, manage and report on execution of deliverables

Qualifications and Experience:

  • MBA / PGDM

Must Have Skills :

  • Proven working experience on Agile Project Management.

  • Experience in Onshore/Offshore software project delivery model

  • Expertise in any Agile Project Management Tool like Jira, Pivotal Tracker etc.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Manages technical components of moderately complex IT projects

  • Working closely with Clients, Higher management and Delivery team

  • Plan, monitor, manage and report on deliverable
